title: rosa trachyphylla f. marginata
intro: Rosa trachyphylla f. marginata, commonly known as Rosa fragrans, is a fragrant, flowering plant species native to India and the Himalayan region. This plant is used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa trachyphylla f. marginata include treating various health conditions such as digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
